notes.title: Release date delayed
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We have an important announcement about Everescape.

Delaying the release is never easy, but our main priority is to make it as good as possible, and we decided to change our strategy in order to be much more efficient and gather as much feedback as possible, so before the release we will do some free beta testing. 

We would like to apologize to everyone who was waiting for the release in the coming days, and we hope you will join the beta testing.

Thank you all!
